name: com.tseng.pickgallery.activity.GalleryPickActivity
description: aWhalefall's PickGallery opens this screen when the app asks the user to choose photos or take a picture; it supports folders, single or multiple selection, and optional cropping before returning the chosen images.
disableEffect: Photo selection and camera capture through PickGallery will stop working, which can interrupt app tasks that need an image.
